# Whisper tiny

OpenAI · released 2022-09 · 0.039B params · apache-2.0

**score 29.0** ±3.4 · #98 of 110 · from 2 benchmark results across 2 sources · \* thinly tested, treat the rank as provisional

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

prior                   pull toward the middle                   49.7                 5% ▇

## How to run it

<pre>
version   needs  score
fp16     ~0.6GB   29.0
fp32     ~0.7GB   29.0
</pre>

```sh
# fp16
uvx --from openai-whisper whisper audio.mp3 --model tiny
# fp32
uv run --with transformers --with torch python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('automatic-speech-recognition', model='openai/whisper-tiny')('audio.wav', return_timestamps=True)['text'])"
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
